sections.heading: Christopher Hall
sections.body: Pr. Hall has served Grace Lutheran since 2012, serving congregations in Enid, OK and Tuscaloosa AL previously. He attended University of Central Oklahoma, receiving a Bachelor degree in Philosophy, summa cum laude, Philosophy student of the year, and Class Marshal/Valedictorian. He attended Concordia Seminary in St. Louis and was an exchange student to Lutherische Theologische Hochschule in Oberursel, Germany in 1997-98. He was ordained on August 13, 2000. Pr. Hall is married to Marjorie and together they have four children. In his free time he enjoys reading, playing cards, board games, and computer games, photography, and supporting the Union High School marching band. He has three dogs, which may be too many.

sections.heading: Marjorie Hall
sections.body:
In June 2013, Marjorie Hall joined the Grace Lutheran Church staff as Youth Coordinator. In this role, she worked closely with the Board of Education to strengthen and expand youth programs, including Cantate Choir, Vacation Bible School, Youth Bell Choir, and other special activities. She also serves as an adult chaperone for youth trips and events, helping provide guidance, support, and encouragement to our young members.

In 2017, Marjorie transitioned into the role of Parish Musician. She continues to share her gifts and talents through her leadership of the Cantate Choir, Adult Choir, Youth and Adult Handbells, and by working with instrumentalists. Through her dedication to music and youth ministry, Marjorie continues to enrich worship and the life of our congregation.

sections.heading: Josh Craig
sections.body:
Josh was called to serve as Director of Christian Education (DCE) in the summer of 2022. He works closely with the Board of Education to support and strengthen the Christian education ministry at Grace Lutheran Church, with a special focus on Junior High and High School youth activities.

In addition to teaching the youth Sunday School class, Josh coordinates and oversees youth events, fundraising activities, and opportunities for spiritual growth and fellowship. He accompanies our youth to Camp Lutherhoma and serves as a chaperone for events such as Higher Things and National Youth Gatherings.

sections.heading: MaKylie Huelsenbeck
sections.body:
Kylie joined the Grace Lutheran Church staff in the fall of 2025 as the Church Secretary and continues to serve in the front office. As one of the first points of contact for members and visitors, she strives to be a welcoming presence and a reflection of the heart of the church. Her responsibilities include a variety of administrative tasks, office support, and maintaining a general knowledge of church activities and ministries.

Kylie considers it both an honor and a privilege to serve at Grace. She has been greatly blessed by the friendships she has formed within the congregation and is thankful for the opportunity to support the ministry and mission of the church.

sections.heading: Tamara Bynum
sections.body:
Tamara joined the Grace Lutheran Church staff in 2021 as our Custodian and Maintenance Worker. While she is responsible for keeping our facilities clean and welcoming, her role extends far beyond routine cleaning. Tamara coordinates and works with a variety of contractors and service providers, including electricians, plumbers, roofers, city inspectors, HVAC technicians, trash removal services, organ repair specialists, and others who help maintain our church building and grounds.

She also assists with clean-up after late-night events and helps ensure that our facilities are ready for the many activities and ministries that take place at Grace. In addition, Tamara is responsible for purchasing kitchen supplies and general maintenance supplies needed to keep our church operating smoothly.

We are grateful for Tamara’s dedication, hard work, and the many ways she helps care for the building and ministry of Grace Lutheran Church.
